source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Άγιος Τρύφων»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. **The whole of the page's text is one sentence: «Ο Άγιος Τρύφων μαρτύρησε δια απαγχονισμού πάνω από μια Ιτιά.»** It gives no year, no reign, no judge and no place, lists no relic and prints no hymn. Its epigram repeats the willow — Tryphon went up in body to a willow tree, and in spirit to the great height of heaven — and nothing else is drafted from it. The corpus keeps five other folders of this name, among them a `tryphon-of-campsada` on 1 Φεβρουαρίου, a `tryphon-companion-of-trophimus` on 29 Σεπτεμβρίου, a `tryphon-of-constantinople` and a `tryphon-of-vyatka`; the page says nothing that would join this hanged martyr to any of them, and two entries on one calendar are two commemorations.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (2 October 2026).
